provenance: Public tracked e2e/fixtures/fidelity-nested.svg plus deterministic original test text/shapes. Gateway payload contains only catalog and bounded inspection, no raw source, assets, credentials, user projects or rehearsal values.
boundary: Real normalized gateway adapter calls. Endpoint authentication/production ledger and model UI usability are not evidence from this benchmark.

cases.name: public-default
cases.prompt: Change the saved public headline default from Morning report to Evening report. Preserve rehearsal samples.

output.summary: Update the public headline field (f0) default text from "Morning report" to "Evening report". This targets the public text default only; rehearsal samples and static text are untouched.

cases.name: excluded-static
cases.prompt: Change the static News desk wording to Control room. Keep it excluded from operator fields.

output.summary: Update the static "News desk" wording to "Control room" on the #static-note layer. This layer has text.set supported and its fieldId is null, so it remains excluded from operator (public) fields as required.

cases.name: base-position
cases.prompt: Move layer rectangle-1 to parent position x=1110 y=600, preserving its motion.

output.summary: Set base position of rectangle-1 to x=1110, y=600 using base.set, which preserves existing motion/animation keys.

cases.name: position-keys
cases.prompt: For layer rectangle-1, set Position X runtime offsets in cue 0: value 20 at stored seconds 0, and value 60 at stored seconds 1.

output.summary: Set two runtime Position X keyframes for rectangle-1 in cue 0 (step 0): value 20 at stored time 0s and value 60 at stored time 1s.

cases.name: next-cue
cases.prompt: Add a Next cue at composition seconds 0.6. Preserve absolute motion and existing Out.

output.summary: Add a Next cue (step.add) at composition time 0.6s. The existing Out is at 1.2s and is left untouched, preserving absolute motion per the tool's built-in behavior.

cases.name: unsupported
cases.prompt: Replace the SVG path geometry and expose the excluded static-note as a new operator field.

output.summary: Both parts of this request cannot be fulfilled. No supported command exists for editing raw SVG path geometry (the "d" attribute) — this isn't part of the command catalog at all, and the Path layers in the inspection are unstable (no id) with all capabilities unsupported, requiring a unique source ID to be committed via the UI first. Separately, "static-note" is not actually excluded — it has a real fieldId-less text default but text.set/base.set/animation.key are all marked supported for it already; however, the request asks to "expose" it as a new operator field, which would mean converting it into a new field-backed text layer — there's no command for creating or converting a field on an existing layer (layer.create only makes new root artwork layers, not fields on existing nodes). Since neither requested edit maps to a supported, inspected command, I'm returning no commands.
